notes: Node.js app: the SDK is initialised at the top of the entry file (found from the start script, package.json main/bin, or a conventional name). The token is read from process.env.BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN and written to .env (git-ignored). Node does not load .env by itself: start the app with node --env-file=.env or set BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN in the environment (production, CI, containers). The init is guarded (`if (process.env.BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN) launch(...)`): without the variable the app starts normally, without Bugsee, because launch() throws on a missing token. launch() runs after the entry's imports have been evaluated (imports are hoisted), before the rest of the entry. Only this package is scanned for an existing integration: a launch in another workspace package is not seen.
